Name: WWISE_VALUE_TO_STR_CONVERT_W_PARAM_ST
Description: Wide-character version of the Wwise value-to-string params: converts a game value (the row ID) into a Wwise switch or state value name (Param String), which is set on the sound.

Fields.Name: Param String
Fields.Description: Wwise switch or state value name set for this row's game value. It must match a value name in the sound banks exactly.
